caption: Onboarding asks how AiSDR should send email, your own Gmail or Outlook or new mailboxes from AiSDR, but offers Skip onboarding, which we used.
About 30 seconds after we gave our website, Deep Search proposed three campaigns, each with an audience, a signal and an angle.
About 3.5 minutes in, Ami showed the first email of a four step sequence, written as a template with merge fields; we created no campaign.
Plans and billing on our free account: 0 message credits, 50 lead search credits and Pay as you go not activated.
